# teams_upgrade_configuration (Resource)

Manages the UpgradeConfiguration configuration via Set-CsTeamsUpgradeConfiguration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `block_legacy_authorization` (Boolean) Maps to the -BlockLegacyAuthorization parameter.
- `download_teams` (Boolean) Maps to the -DownloadTeams parameter.
- `sf_b_meeting_join_ux` (String) Maps to the -SfBMeetingJoinUx parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
